# Pandamonium v1.0.68

Operator-requested train for the Myinstants soundboard: Jarvis can find favorites and place separate effects in spoken responses. This includes the already-merged MAD-957–MAD-963 plugin foundations since v1.0.67, plus MAD-968. The paused MAD-964 branch is excluded. Installation and deployment are verified separately from publication. Rollback is the retained signed v1.0.67 release and updater snapshot, plus the retained Chatterbox image and service configuration.

## MAD-957 — Install verified integration package contents

### Problem

Generated integration files were lost when marketplace installs fetched source again.

### Implementation

Installation now retains and verifies the prepared archive, generated files, executable modes and exact tree identity.

### Product value and UI visibility

Marketplace installs use the tested package bytes.

### Verification

6,419 local Python tests and actual disposable authenticated lifecycle proof; final release CI is authoritative.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

No owner configuration or runtime data enters the immutable package. Existing native skills and MCP paths remain supported.

### References

- [MAD-957](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-957)
- [PR #262](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/262)

## MAD-958 — Prepare source-backed integrations from repository URLs

### Problem

Repository classification alone did not produce an executable integration or explain setup.

### Implementation

The scan binds proposed interfaces and typed arguments to inspected source evidence, retains the prepared package, and persists cancellation/status.

### Product value and UI visibility

The URL scan explains purpose, setup and preparation status and recovers after reload.

### Verification

95 focused checks, six browser checks and a disposable full-app source/model transport fixture; 6,438 local Python tests.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Configured-owner models may adapt new URL scans. The Myinstants package in this release is prepared deterministically and does not call a model during installation. General semantic accuracy is not certified by fixture evidence.

### References

- [MAD-958](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-958)
- [PR #263](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/263)

## MAD-959 — Run generated CLI packages with native authority

### Problem

Prepared CLI integrations had no owner-scoped isolated execution path.

### Implementation

Native dispatch validates package identity and typed operations, then runs declared entrypoints through bubblewrap with private runtime data and normal authority.

### Product value and UI visibility

Installed CLI tools can run through the existing agent workflow and keep artifacts across upgrades.

### Verification

Real pinned yt-dlp/PandaFlix operations and native Ponytail admission, lifecycle/owner checks, and 6,446 local Python tests.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Linux bubblewrap and util-linux are required. The following runtime changes add aggregate resource enforcement. No unsandboxed fallback exists; network declarations are not destination firewalls.

### References

- [MAD-959](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-959)
- [PR #264](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/264)

## MAD-960 — Bound package services and expose setup requirements

### Problem

Managed services, connected APIs and knowledge packages needed resource bounds and explicit owner configuration.

### Implementation

The shared runtime validates service health, encrypted configuration references, cgroup limits, finite runtime storage and device prerequisites.

### Product value and UI visibility

Plugins show required setup and can start, stop and recover their own managed service.

### Verification

Retained real operation receipts in docs/mad-960-package-corpus.json and targeted runtime, configuration, isolation and lifecycle regressions.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Executable packages require a systemd user manager, cgroup v2 and dedicated persistent storage no larger than 8 GiB / 1,000,000 inodes. Missing prerequisites leave Needs setup; no production dependency or database schema was added to the app.

### References

- [MAD-960](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-960)
- [PR #265](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/265)

## MAD-961 — Show plugin purpose and owner-scoped readiness

### Problem

Plugin cards exposed implementation details without a clear purpose or trustworthy readiness.

### Implementation

Shared metadata and lifecycle evidence now drive purpose, capabilities, examples, setup and Ready/Needs setup/Disabled states across plugin views and native discovery.

### Product value and UI visibility

Installed and marketplace cards open an accessible detail view with setup and lifecycle controls.

### Verification

Real authenticated Ponytail install/read/disable/enable/remove, desktop/mobile captures, 185 Chromium checks and 6,467 local Python tests.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

An enabled registry row alone is not executable readiness. Browsing does not call third-party services or mount tools; legacy metadata remains optional.

### References

- [MAD-961](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-961)
- [PR #266](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/266)

## MAD-962 — Publish tested packages and discover the signed marketplace

### Problem

Offering a plugin previously stopped at an unsigned submission artifact.

### Implementation

The publisher validates exact package bytes, signs and uploads immutable GitHub assets, atomically updates the signed catalog and verifies readback.

### Product value and UI visibility

Add to marketplace reports Published only after public readback; fresh installs discover the shared catalog.

### Verification

Actual producer publication and independent fresh-consumer installation/removal, signed catalog rollback/reapply, 45 final focused checks and 10 browser checks.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Publishing requires the existing trusted Ed25519 key and authenticated GitHub on a publisher host. Consumers need neither. Local operator-managed trust stores remain explicit local channels.

### References

- [MAD-962](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-962)
- [PR #269](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/269)

## MAD-963 — Reconcile the requested plugin inventory with real capability evidence

### Problem

The requested inventory mixed published capabilities, setup gaps and unverified claims.

### Implementation

Reviewed packages, native operation receipts and a source-pinned inventory now distinguish supported operations, partial coverage, outstanding setup/license issues and held-out sources.

### Product value and UI visibility

The signed catalog exposes tested packages with useful descriptions and honest limitations.

### Verification

Real native operations and fresh-consumer discovery/install/remove; retained inventory/publication digests; 91 focused and 46 final source/inventory regressions.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

This release does not install the catalog wholesale, certify outstanding capabilities or resume held-out MAD-964 work. Only Myinstants is installed for this scoped deployment.

## MAD-968 — Give Jarvis a Myinstants soundboard in text and voice

### Problem

Myinstants exposed only recent sounds and Jarvis could not place a sound in speech.

### Implementation

The native plugin now supplies search, detail, recent and owner favorites. Validated response cues render manual text controls and schedule separate effect sources from Chatterbox attention timing in the existing speech clock. Voice mode exposes the enabled owner soundboard; downloads begin alongside speech synthesis.

### Product value and UI visibility

Settings → Soundboard provides search, preview, favorites and independent effects volume/mute. Voice can play a selected sound after a particular repeated-word occurrence while speech continues.

### Verification

Real Myinstants lifecycle and media proof; actual self-hosted Jarvis tool selection; six seed-matched real Chatterbox waveform/token parity checks and browser loopback accepted by Leo; focused Python and Chromium regressions. Exact candidate CI and installed acceptance remain release gates.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Enabled, unchanged plugin services recover from installer/app exit on their next use; owner, package, configuration and sandbox checks remain enforced. Requires Myinstants package 1.1.1 and the separately deployed Chatterbox timing patch. Attention timings are approximate, with the demonstrated behavior accepted by Leo. Missing/late media skips the effect visibly, preserving speech. No Whisper, second timing model, paid fallback, changed voice defaults or resynthesis.

### References

- [MAD-968](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-968)
- [PR #275](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/275)
